title: A zinc atom gives electrons
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the model.

knows: Symbols can represent chemical substances or states.
doesNotKnow: The oxidation half-reaction Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ shows zinc losing two electrons. Electron loss is oxidation; the zinc nucleus does not lose two protons.

misconception: The process produces a different result from the one shown.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: A zinc atom becomes Zn²⁺. What happened to its electrons? The oxidation half-reaction Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ shows zinc losing two electrons. Electron loss is oxidation; the zinc nucleus does not lose two protons.
The circles are symbolic labels, not molecular structures, and the model omits other conditions or intermediate steps.
